xBRIEFInfo.description: Approved change proposal for the Module 8 curriculum scope
xBRIEFInfo.author: agent:codex

narratives.Problem: Learners can identify implementation authority through Module 7, but they cannot yet choose a safe session posture or select authorized work from ordered plans, ranked queues, active scope, and live operator intent.
narratives.Change: Author Module 8, its fixed fictional request cards and state snapshots, an explained solution, source and navigation updates, and a focused verifier with negative tests.
narratives.Scope: In scope: the paths and five acceptance clauses declared by training.modules6-8.sessions, the approved Module 8 cost record, the generated project and parent-scope lifecycle updates, and the governed pending-to-active child transition. Out of scope: Module 9 and later curriculum, live GitHub backlogs, real Directive caches, confidential project state, learner remotes, publishing, deployment, upstream framework changes, push, pull-request creation, and merge.
narratives.Impact: Adds one learner-ready lesson and deterministic decision exercise that distinguish read-only orientation from mutation sessions, session recovery from cold start, ordered-plan precedence from ranked-queue selection, and informative state from implementation authority.
narratives.Risks: The lesson could expose live project state, teach stale command behavior, imply that a cache or completed scope authorizes implementation, or overstate platform validation. Fixed fictional snapshots, exact 0.112.0 evidence, explicit 0.114.0 drift notes, negative tests, and platform labels must prevent those failures.
narratives.Approach: Revalidate the pinned session and work-selection command surfaces first, write failing verifier tests, implement the smallest fixed-state lesson and solution that satisfy the five clauses, update navigation and source records, then run focused checks, literal acceptance, conformance, and the aggregate gate.
narratives.Alternatives: A live-backlog lab was rejected because it would expose mutable or confidential state and would not be reproducible. Combining Module 8 with Modules 9 through 11 was rejected because the approved decomposition makes work selection an independently verifiable story.
narratives.Dependencies: The completed Module 7 curriculum, the exact @deftai/directive 0.112.0 project pin, the installed 0.114.0 engine used only for drift comparison, Node.js 20 or newer, Git, npm, and the repository's existing Markdown and verifier patterns.
narratives.Authorization: David selected Build for the Module 8 estimate and approved /deft:directive:change module-8-curriculum by replying “built it” after the explicit confirmation request. This confirms local implementation and the related cost-estimate and project-reference edits only; it does not authorize remote delivery or destructive cleanup.
narratives.Stops: Success: all Module 8 focused acceptance commands, negative verifier tests, conformance checks, and the aggregate local gate pass. Failure: at most five implementation fix iterations or three identical failures without progress, and at most three pre-PR review passes. Stop before push or pull-request creation pending separate authorization.
